question: What are the five largest transfer fees paid by a Premier League club (incoming transfers) in the data?

sql:
SELECT p.player_name, pt.to_team, pt.from_team, pt.season, pt.transfer_fee
FROM player_transfers pt
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = pt.player_id
WHERE pt.to_team IN (
    SELECT t.team_name
    FROM teams t
    JOIN matches m ON m.home_team_id = t.team_id OR m.away_team_id = t.team_id
    JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id = m.season_id
    WHERE s.competition_id = 1
)
  AND pt.transfer_fee IS NOT NULL
  AND pt.transfer_fee ~ '^[0-9.]+$'
ORDER BY pt.transfer_fee::numeric DESC
LIMIT 5;

out.notes: player_transfers.to_team (text name) is the incoming/buying club; filter to_team to canonical PL club names (join against teams.team_name to restrict to Premier League clubs, since transfers table has no league column). Order by transfer_fee DESC, LIMIT 5. Note transfer_fee is text/numeric — cast/clean as needed and exclude NULL/loan/free rows. Join players(player_id) for player_name display. Grain: one row per transfer.
